accepted.sentence: In dining rooms, low enclosed units often keep table linens and serving pieces near the table without occupying much wall height.
Entryways often use shallow enclosed furniture to contain shoes and outdoor accessories near the door.
In bedrooms, built-in compartments can keep folded garments and personal belongings out of sight.
In under-stair spaces, custom-fitted doors conceal compartments shaped to use otherwise awkward sloping areas.
Outdoor kitchens may use weather-resistant enclosures to protect utensils and serving supplies from rain and airborne debris.
In childcare settings, cleaning products are kept in locked, high compartments to prevent access by young children.
In server rooms, ventilated enclosures organize network equipment while allowing airflow around heat-producing components.
In dining halls, serving stations provide enclosed spaces for spare trays and tableware near food service areas.
